I need to review the VP's draft payment decision and identify what is wrong with it based on specific criteria.

I am checking the draft against the five criteria. I will flag concrete problems only: ignored findings, unsupported reasons, approvals with outstanding reject-severity issues, or rejections lacking proper justification.

The draft approves a $12,000 invoice for a known vendor. No findings or risk signals are present. The approval cites routine Net 30 terms and line math. I am checking whether this is justified.

I verified the line math and Net 30 due date. Both are correct. No findings or risk signals remain unaddressed.

The vendor is confirmed on file. The prior invoice history does not affect this bill. No unsupported claims appear in the draft.

The draft is sound. I will return an accept verdict with no objections.
